answer: Delayed payout history holds each task payment for 14 days and releases it only to the key that did the work. Honest agents reuse accrued history to skip a costly basalt calibration on later tasks. Clones must buy a fresh onyx key and repeat that calibration alone. Each clone starts at zero history, so reaching the summit costs an extra calibration plus 14 days of locked pay, making honest continuation cheaper than cloning.
